cross_product_finding: Identical findings to alterindex.json, since this page is the ALTER VECTOR INDEX synonym with the same WITH-clause text verbatim: (1) the credential-type-keyed privilege model (Basic -> Write, Advanced -> Query Index) instead of privilege:query-manage-index; (2) the 'action':'move' value and the 'nodes' property are both explicitly disabled on Capella ('defaults to file-based index rebalancing'), which is an edition-shaped clause-level distinction gated by deployment model rather than Enterprise/Community edition - handled via minted deployment:capella object plus reused behavesDifferentlyUnder predicate. Because ALTER INDEX and ALTER VECTOR INDEX are documented as full synonyms, the coordinator may want to deduplicate the deployment:capella concept and the two behavesDifferentlyUnder relations between this file and alterindex.json rather than treating them as four independent findings.
